heading_en: Credit Risk-Weighted Assets for Central Counterparty-Related Exposures
summary_ja: 第三章及び第四章にかかわらず、中央清算機関に対するトレード・エクスポージャー、清算基金等の信用リスク・アセットはこの章により計算する。
summary_en: Notwithstanding Chapters 3 and 4, credit RWA for trade exposures to a central counterparty, default funds and certain trade exposures to clearing participants are calculated under this Chapter.
paragraphs: Notwithstanding the provisions of Chapter 3 and Chapter 4, the calculation of the credit risk-weighted assets of the exposures listed in the following items shall be as provided in this Chapter. (i) Trade exposures to a central counterparty. (ii) The default fund relating to a central counterparty. (iii) Where the Ultimate Designated Parent Company is an indirect clearing participant, trade exposures to a direct clearing participant that satisfy the requirements listed in Article 248-2, paragraph (2), item (ii)(a) and (b) (referred to as "trade exposures to direct clearing participants" in the following Article).

terms.ja: 直接清算参加者向けトレード・エクスポージャー
terms.en: trade exposures to direct clearing participants
